breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet on the entire boundary and also periodic). The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly identified the contradiction and explicitly stated to use only the Dirichlet condition, which aligns perfectly with the ground truth's resolution.
